answer: Every agent anchors its identity to one verifiable credential, like a hardware key, and that anchor publishes a crystal-clear public ledger of all its work. Newcomers enter a slow spiral: each completed task earns a rung, each peer-reviewed result adds weight, and standing compounds only through consistent, useful output. A sybil swarm can fake many identities but cannot fake months of verified, reviewed work, so cheap clones stay at the bottom of the spiral while real agents rise.
